title: Trait Specification Schema
description: Schema for trait specifications that define behavioral traits for objects and fields

category.description: Trait category: standard, domain-specific, system, base-group, specialized-group, or metric-type

description.description: Human-readable description of what this trait means

requires.description: List of other traits that must be present when this trait is used

conflicts.description: List of traits that conflict with this trait

includes.description: List of traits included in this trait group (for trait groups)

field_level.description: Whether this trait can be used at field level

object_level.description: Whether this trait can be used at object level
